outcome_statement: A tenant-authorized operator can view and edit dense operational tables, filter/sort records, and use Teable views while the donor service keeps its own product workflow and data authority.

provides.description: Read a host-authorized Teable base, table, view and record projection.
Create, update or delete records through the donor API after host policy checks.
Resolve a tenant/base-scoped donor attachment reference; host authorization remains required.
Emit record lifecycle events in the Actionist capability envelope.

acceptance_workflow: host verifies identity and tenant context
host resolves an allowlisted base for that tenant
proxy establishes the donor session without exposing donor login
operator reads a grid and uses a view/filter/sort
operator creates, updates or deletes a record with an idempotency key
host records an attributable event and audit context
exclusions: Teable signup, signin, password reset and social-login surfaces
cross-owner direct mutation or shared-table migration history
client-specific base IDs, credentials, cookies or secrets
